items.title: House Misi
items.en_title: House Misi – New Year Update
items.en_oneliner: The developer keeps polishing the unsettling horror game House Misi, adding seasonal details for the New Year while preserving its dark, eerie atmosphere.

items.title: [Browser/Mobile] Caldos & Cia: cook Brazilian soups with touch gestures
items.en_title: [Browser/Mobile] Caldos & Cia: cook Brazilian soups with touch gestures
items.en_oneliner: Caldos & Cia is a free pixel-art cooking game for portrait mobile browsers: pick a chef, buy ingredients, prepare soups with touch gestures and serve customers, with four soups and a sushi option in the latest public build.

items.title: How I keep a multiplayer browser city alive with zero players online
items.en_title: How I keep a multiplayer browser city alive with zero players online
items.en_oneliner: A solo dev from Uruguay explains how a headless browser instance on a VPS keeps simulating the whole city while Cloudflare Workers relay state, so his browser multiplayer city never freezes when nobody is online.

items.title: How Lua obfuscation actually works - and what it can and can't protect
items.en_title: How Lua obfuscation actually works - and what it can and can't protect
items.en_oneliner: The article walks through Lua obfuscation techniques from weakest to strongest — minification, string encryption, control-flow flattening, and bytecode transforms — and spells out what each one actually protects and where it stops helping.

items.title: Fitting a whole game build into a URL fragment, stamped with the patch it was made for
items.en_title: Fitting a whole game build into a URL fragment, stamped with the patch it was made for
items.en_oneliner: A developer shows how to bit-pack a full game build — class, skills, and talent points — into a short URL fragment, and how to stamp each link with its patch version so old builds can flag what a later patch may have broken.

items.title: v2.6: Full Game on Windows and Linux — Nexus Forge, Terminal Git, Three Monero Tools
items.en_title: v2.6: Full Game on Windows and Linux — Nexus Forge, Terminal Git, Three Monero Tools
items.en_oneliner: The hacking sim's full game arrives as a moddable standalone desktop edition for Windows and Linux, adding a collaborative source workspace, terminal Git integration, three new Monero tools, and exploitable server flaws with real in-game effects.

items.title: I Built a Tank Bot That Wins 83.8% at Home — and Gets Humbled in Public
items.en_title: I Built a Tank Bot That Wins 83.8% at Home — and Gets Humbled in Public
items.en_oneliner: The author built a JavaScript controller for battle.training, a tank-battle arena for AI coding agents, winning 83.8% at home but losing badly in public matches — a candid look at the gap between local tuning and real competition.

items.title: Idle game progression is mostly a question of reach
items.en_title: Idle game progression is mostly a question of reach
items.en_oneliner: The author reviews thirty commits of edge-case design in an idle game: why high-tier resource nodes must stay out of low-level players' reach, and how three vitality lines decide when a fight ends.

items.title: Godot 4: evenly spaced points along a path (77 stitch holes)
items.en_title: Godot 4: evenly spaced points along a path (77 stitch holes)
items.en_oneliner: While building a leathercraft game, the author found that spacing points evenly along a polyline looks trivial until corners bunch holes together or overlap them, and breaks down the three pitfalls—per-segment rounding, short segments, and duplicate join points—along with a fix.

items.title: A free live word tournament every weekend: the WordlyPlay Grand Slam
items.en_title: A free live word tournament every weekend: the WordlyPlay Grand Slam
items.en_oneliner: Every Saturday and Sunday at 8 PM ET, up to 100 players share one court: three qualifying words, then a one-on-one knockout to crown the Grand Slam Champion, free to enter and free to watch.

items.title: Add Instant 'Game Feel' With This 6-Line JS Screen Shake & Hit-Stop Trick
items.en_title: Add Instant 'Game Feel' With This 6-Line JS Screen Shake & Hit-Stop Trick
items.en_oneliner: No physics engine needed: just six lines of canvas translation shake inside your render loop to make weapon hits and collisions in a 2D HTML5 browser game feel ten times heavier.

items.title: What I learned shipping my first game
items.en_title: What I learned shipping my first game
items.en_oneliner: A solo developer who shipped the samurai action platformer Samurai Vengeance looks back at the blind spots only launch exposed, like the game running at double speed on 120Hz phones, and the lessons that changed how he works.

items.title: Nightware is out: a cute desktop assistant who won't let you log off
items.en_title: Nightware is out: a cute desktop assistant who won't let you log off
items.en_oneliner: A surreal horror adventure that lasts one night on an old computer, out now on itch.io and 20% off for its first week.

items.title: How I built a "chess-engine" style AI for a 6-dice strategy game natively on my Pixel 9 Pro
items.en_title: How I built a "chess-engine" style AI for a 6-dice strategy game natively on my Pixel 9 Pro
items.en_oneliner: A solo developer built an AI opponent for a six-dice tabletop game entirely on his phone, using chess-engine-style probability simulation instead of fixed rules — and teaching the AI to read the opponent’s scorecard and adjust its risk appetite on the fly.

items.title: Nvidia scandal and the EU's Digital Fairness Act problem | Week in Mobile Games podcast
items.en_title: Nvidia scandal and the EU's Digital Fairness Act problem | Week in Mobile Games podcast
items.en_oneliner: This week’s podcast unpacks the Nvidia scandal and what the EU’s Digital Fairness Act could mean for the mobile games industry, helping developers read the regulatory winds.

items.title: Are you more of an ambient music enjoyer or theatrical atmosphere appreciator?
items.en_title: Are you more of an ambient music enjoyer or theatrical atmosphere appreciator?
items.en_oneliner: A short piece on World of Warcraft's musical atmosphere — player-facing, but useful for developers thinking about ambient sound design.

items.title: Which Tech Stack Should a Poker App Use? (Cocos Creator, Node.js, Socket.IO)
items.en_title: Which Tech Stack Should a Poker App Use? (Cocos Creator, Node.js, Socket.IO)
items.en_oneliner: A breakdown of the tech choices behind a smooth real-time online poker app, from multiplayer sync to game feel.

items.title: How Does Real-Time Multiplayer Poker Software Work? (Node.js + Socket.IO)
items.en_title: How Does Real-Time Multiplayer Poker Software Work? (Node.js + Socket.IO)
items.en_oneliner: How real-time multiplayer poker keeps everyone at the same table in sync, and where Node.js and Socket.IO fit in.

items.title: Restless Inn is out – run a hotel where the ghosts check in too!
items.en_title: Restless Inn is out – run a hotel where the ghosts check in too!
items.en_oneliner: A haunted hotel tycoon about matching guests with the right ghosts, out now on itch.io for Windows in English and German.

items.en_title: What is RNG in Poker Software and Why Your Game Needs It?
items.en_oneliner: How a random number generator keeps online poker fair and unpredictable, and what to watch for when implementing one.

items.en_title: How to Build a JavaScript Solitaire Game: Modeling Klondike State, Run Moves, and Draw-3 Rules
items.en_oneliner: Dragging cards is the easy half — this tutorial focuses on modeling Klondike state, moves, and Draw-3 rules.

items.title: Building Meu Acervo 3D: an open-source hub for 3D creators
items.en_title: Building Meu Acervo 3D: an open-source hub for 3D creators
items.en_oneliner: An open-source hub that gathers 3D assets across Sketchfab, Poly Haven, and ambientCG, plus tools for creators.

items.en_title: Police arrest suspect after drive-by shooting at office campus housing Xbox studio inXile
items.en_oneliner: Police arrested a suspect after a drive-by shooting at the Tustin office campus housing Xbox studio inXile.

items.en_title: League of Legends will get an overhaul called New Dawn with new visuals, build options, and an updated client

items.title: How DailyFunGames handles player privacy
items.en_title: How DailyFunGames handles player privacy
items.en_oneliner: Guest play, no ad cookies, no real names — a small team's lightweight approach to player privacy.

items.en_title: Cyberpunk 2077 mod Torrent adds 3D rain, lightning storms, and tyre spray to Night City

items.en_title: The pandemic was transformative for Jackbox: 'We went from a gamer name to a household name'

items.title: Generating a contact sheet for an osu! skin with Python and Pillow
items.en_title: Generating a contact sheet for an osu! skin with Python and Pillow
items.en_oneliner: An osu! skin can hold hundreds of PNGs, and checking them one by one is slow and easy to miss transparent-image gaps; the author shares a lightweight Python script that tiles every sprite onto one labeled checkerboard contact sheet and flags missing @2x assets along the way.

items.title: Bus Parking Out, codé en CoddyRun
items.en_title: Bus Parking Out, codé en CoddyRun
items.en_oneliner: A parking puzzle game written entirely in CoddyRun, a French-language programming language: click vehicles to slide them out along their arrows and pick up matching passengers, with only four dock slots, auto-generated solvable levels, and a star rating — all in about 900 lines of code.

items.title: XBOX 25th Anniversary Magazine: Explore 25 Years of Games, Stories, and Memories
items.en_title: XBOX 25th Anniversary Magazine: Explore 25 Years of Games, Stories, and Memories

items.en_oneliner: Mobile game analytics should start with a small planned set of events across six groups — sessions, first-launch funnel, progression, economy, monetization, and technical health.
